entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I need to start a return for an order I received recently.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-012. It's for a pair of cycling shoes.

Got it, thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the Pro-Cycle shoes delivered on November 26th. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a fit and comfort issue. I took them on one ride and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. I also felt like the positioning for the cleats wasn't quite right for my pedal style.

I'm very sorry to hear they caused you blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I'm looking at your order date, and you are well within our 90-day return period. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.

Okay, a refund sounds good. I appreciate you making that easy. Since I did have a pretty negative experience and now need to box everything up again, is there any chance you could offer a small discount code for a future purchase? I'd like to try a different pair of cycling shoes from you all.

I understand your position. While I can't add a promotional discount on top of the full refund, I can assure you the return process will be simple. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label to send to your email right now. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed immediately.
Alright, that's fair. As long as the return is free, I'm okay with that. So the full refund is confirmed?
Yes, a full refund to your original payment method. The email with the label is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
